title: GeoLibre launches free browser GIS with 1000+ tools and AI #GeoLibre #openSourceGIS #geospatialdata
description: Qiu Shengwu developed GeoLibre, a free open source GIS tool that runs entirely in your browser. GeoLibre offers features similar to Quantum GIS and Google Earth Pro, including 2D and full 3D city exploration, planetary travel, historical views, and customizable map building without any installation. GeoLibre supports over 1000 geoprocessing tools and integrates an AI assistant that translates plain English requests into spatial analyses. It is compatible with Windows, Mac, Linux, and has a native Android app for offline use, providing a versatile alternative to paid GIS software. With Google Earth Pro transitioning to a paid subscription model, GeoLibre delivers powerful GIS capabilities at no cost, making advanced geospatial technology accessible to a wider audience, from professionals to enthusiasts. #GeoLibre #QiuShengwu #GIS #OpenSourceGIS #GeospatialAnalysis #QuantumGIS #GoogleEarthPro #Geoprocessing #SpatialAI #MappingSoftware #3DGIS #GeospatialTechnology #GISforEveryone #OfflineGIS #CartographyTools
